cards.text: Samson, the son born to Manoah and his wife (Judges 13:24), has grown up now, friend. One day he goes down to Timnah, where he sees a young Philistine woman. So he heads right back home to his father and mother.

cards.question: Samson's back home with his father and mother. What does he tell them about the young woman in Timnah?

answers.text: Now get her for me as a wife
She has invited us all to Timnah
Her father wants to meet you both

cards.question: Samson's father and mother aren't on board with this. What do they ask him?

answers.text: Can't you find a wife among our own people
Why were you in Timnah without us
Has her father agreed to any of this

cards.text: Samson tells his father, "Get her for me, for she is pleasing to my eyes." That's the whole argument, friend: no pros, no cons, no slideshow, just PLEASING. TO. MY. EYES.

cards.question: Then the writer adds a side note. Samson's father and mother didn't know something about all this. What was it?

answers.text: This was from the LORD
She was already promised to someone
Samson had met her family before

cards.question: The LORD was seeking an occasion to move against the ___, because at that time they were ruling over Israel.

answers.text: Philistines
Moabites
Amorites

cards.text: So Samson heads down to Timnah with his father and mother, and they come to the vineyards of Timnah. Then, suddenly, something comes roaring at him.

cards.question: In the vineyards of Timnah, a young ___ comes roaring at Samson.

answers.text: lion
bear
boar

cards.text: Me? I'd have hopped my gold base all the way back home, friend, and I wouldn't have stopped to wave. But then the Spirit of the LORD comes powerfully upon Samson.

cards.question: With the Spirit of the LORD on him, what does Samson do to the young lion?

answers.text: Tears it apart with his bare hands
Drives it off with his staff
Chases it out of the vineyards

cards.question: Samson rushes to tell his father and mother what he just did to the lion.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: Samson keeps on his way and talks with the woman, because, that line again, she was pleasing to his eyes. Lion? What lion?
Later, Samson goes back to take her as his wife, and he leaves the road to go see the lion's carcass. That's like swinging back by the pothole that popped your tire, just to see how it's doing.

cards.question: Inside the lion's carcass, Samson finds a swarm of ___ along with their ___.

answers.text: bees
honey
birds
young
locusts

cards.question: Samson shares some of the honey with his father and mother.

answers.text: True
False

cards.question: Samson scooped that honey into his hands and ate it on the way. When he gives some to his father and mother, what does he leave out?

answers.text: He took it from the lion's carcass
The woman in Timnah gave it to him
He traded for it at the market in Timnah

cards.text: Samson's father goes to visit the woman, and Samson prepares a feast there, as was customary for the bridegroom. A wedding feast, friend, and you KNOW I'm wishing I could be in the back running the ovens.

cards.question: When the Philistines see Samson, they pick ___ men to keep him company at the feast.

answers.text: thirty
seven
twelve

cards.text: A room full of brand new companions, and Samson's got an icebreaker ready. "Let me tell you a riddle," Samson says to them.

cards.question: Samson makes his riddle a bet. If the thirty men solve it within the seven days of the feast, what will he give them?

answers.text: Thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes
Thirty shekels of silver and thirty young goats
Thirty donkeys and thirty bronze shields

cards.text: If they can't solve it, they owe HIM the same, and they're ready to hear it. So Samson says: "Out of the eater came something to eat, and out of the strong came something sweet."

cards.question: Samson's riddle says something to eat came out of the eater, and something sweet came out of the strong. What is it really about?

answers.text: The honey in the lion's carcass
The grapes in the vineyards of Timnah
The feast he prepared for the wedding

cards.text: For three days they can't explain the riddle. That's me with a new oven timer, friend: day one, poking buttons, day THREE, still beeping.

cards.question: On the fourth day, the thirty men go to Samson's ___ to get the answer.

answers.text: wife
father
mother

cards.text: And it isn't a friendly ask. They tell Samson's wife, "Entice your husband to explain the riddle to us, or we will burn you and your father's household to death. Did you invite us here to rob us?"

cards.question: Samson's wife comes to him weeping. What does she tell him?

answers.text: You do not really love me
My father wants you to leave
The feast has to end tonight

cards.text: Samson answers, "I have not even explained it to my father or mother, so why should I explain it to you?" Oh, FRIEND. I'm a cookie stamper, and even I know that answer isn't going to stop the crying.

cards.question: Samson's wife weeps for only one day of the feast.

answers.text: True
False

cards.question: Samson's wife weeps the whole seven days, and on the seventh day he finally tells her the answer. Then she explains the riddle to her ___.

answers.text: people
mother
sisters

cards.text: Before sunset on the seventh day, the men of the city stroll up to Samson: "What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than a lion?" Talk about RIGHT before the buzzer.
Samson answers them with a farm picture: "If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have solved my riddle!"
Then the Spirit of the LORD comes mightily upon Samson. He goes down to Ashkelon, a Philistine city (Joshua 13:3), kills thirty men there and takes their apparel.

cards.question: Samson takes the clothes from Ashkelon. What does he do with them?

answers.text: Gives them to the men who solved the riddle
Takes them home to his father's house
Leaves them with his wife's father

cards.question: After paying off the bet, Samson heads back to his father's house burning with anger.

answers.text: True
False

cards.question: Samson's gone back to his father's house. What happens to his wife?

answers.text: She is given to one of the men who accompanied him
She goes with Samson to his father's house
She is sent away to live in Ashkelon

cards.text: Hang on to your apron, friend, because this story is NOT done.
